name: tkt
description: Git-native ticket tracking and workflow skills for ready work, ticket execution, orientation, and reconciliation. Requires the tkt CLI and Git.
author: smileynet
skillInstructions: Before ticket operations, verify tkt --version and git --version succeed. If either is missing, stop and tell the user to install the missing prerequisite. Use tkt close to complete tickets; never hand-edit ticket status to done.

interface.longDescription: Track tickets as Markdown files, work the dependency-graph frontier, and keep plans current with four tkt workflow skills. Requires the separately installed tkt CLI and Git.
tryPrompts: Show me what ticket work is ready
Pick up the next frontier ticket
Review my ticket board and plan

tkt-core.description: Track tickets, inspect the frontier, and manage the ticket lifecycle

tkt-work.description: Claim, execute, verify, and close frontier tickets

tkt-orient.description: Resume session state and propose the next ticket

tkt-reconcile.description: Audit tickets and align the plan with current priorities
